assessments.reasoning: The survey records relationships between household members in Section 1, Question 5 strictly relative to the household head ("¿Qué parentesco tiene con la jefa o jefe del hogar?"). It does not collect member-to-member relationships using a triangular grid or pointer variables, so member_to_member_relationships is false. It includes categories beyond spouse and parent-child, such as grandchild, grandparent, sibling, and non-kin ("NIETA O NIETO", "ABUELA O ABUELO", "HERMANA O HERMANO", "OTRO QUE NO ES PARIENTE"), so extended_ties is true. The text does not state explicit operational criteria for distinguishing multiple households residing within the same dwelling, so multiple_household_criteria is false. It does not contain variables or coding to identify family nuclei or sub-units within the household, so sub_units is false. Finally, while caregiving is cited as a reason for school non-attendance or job leaving in options like "CUIDADO DE MIEMBROS DEL HOGAR", the instrument does not capture specific caregiving relationships identifying who cares for whom, so caregiving_relationships is false.
